description: This source file provides a utility function 'stripMarkdown' that removes lightweight markdown formatting from text while preserving readability for TTS and fallback channels. It performs regex-based substitutions to strip bold, italics, underline, strikethrough, headers, blockquotes, separators, inline code, and reduces multiple newlines.
